nodes.name: App.svelte
nodes.description: Main application UI component — build planner with item selection modals, drag-and-drop armor/ring slots, draconic abilities, enchant management, CDR display, stat breakdown, search/filter with fuzzy matching, undo/clear build

nodes.name: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
nodes.description: Damage calculation display component — computes per-hit damage for M1/M2/WA/Rune/Perk groups, defense grid with training dummy, debuff pills with variants, daily challenge presets, enemy HP slider, DoT display, armor penetration, crit toggle, detailed tooltip formulas

nodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
nodes.description: Core analysis orchestration component — coordinates boost entries, category multipliers, weapon damage type resolution with perk conversions (Spirit Winds, Dark Magic), weapon art parsing, scaling breakdowns, debuff management, draconic runes/infusion, perk-based damage entries (PERK_DMG_DEFS), DoT ticks, disabled boosts/buffs, mount rune handling, self-damage, heal scaling/boost, emotional state, proc-chip effects, critical hit calculations

nodes.name: selfDamagePerks.ts
nodes.description: Self-damage perk definitions and calculation — defines 5 self-damage perks (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier, Steam Powered) with calcSelfDamage() supporting multi-target falloff, defense multipliers, DR, flat vs percentage damage

nodes.name: EmotionalTracker.svelte
nodes.description: Emotional perk state toggle UI component — three-state selector (debuff-only / both / buff-only) with styled buttons, slider, and dynamic color/glow/border/bg theming, connected to the build store's emotionalState key

nodes.name: boosts.ts
nodes.description: Shared boost multiplier constants — defines ~60 exported constants including Frenzy, Minion Absorption, heal values, per-stack multipliers, and complex boost constants for Venom Eater, Ferocity Tenacity, Spirit Winds, Guardian Spin, Wild Bolt, Heat Drill, Essence Ray, Steam Powered

nodes.name: App
nodes.description: Root application Svelte component — manages build state, item selection modals (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon parts), drag-and-drop armor/ring grid, draconic ability cycling, enchantment inline editing and swapping, search with substring Levenshtein matching, stat/perk/tag filtering, undo/clear build, tabbed overview/analyze layout

nodes.name: BaseDamageCalc
nodes.description: Damage calculator Svelte component — receives weaponHits and typedBoostEntries as props, computes computedHits with full damage formula (base × scaling × typed boost × combat mult × def mult × debuff mult × self-debuff mult), groups hits by M1/M2/WA/Rune/Perk, displays per-type breakdowns with hover tooltips, manages training dummy debuffs with variant cycling, defense grid with persistence, DoT tick display with detailed formula tooltips

nodes.name: DamageAnalyzer
nodes.description: Core analysis orchestrator Svelte component — consumes BaseDamageCalc, coordinates all boost/perk/buff/debuff/damage logic including weapon damage type resolution with elemental conversions, scaling computation, category multipliers (M1/M2/WA/Rune/Perk), debuff aggregation with auto-debuffs, draconic runes/infusion buffs, perk damage entries (PERK_DMG_DEFS) for on-hit finisher effects, DoT computation, self-damage from perks, heal scaling/boost, critical hit breakdown, mount rune handling, emotional state bonuses, proc-chip effects

nodes.name: EmotionalTracker
nodes.description: Emotional perk state toggle — renders a 3-state selector (debuff/both/buff) with styled buttons and a range slider, updates the build store's emotionalState key, displays dynamic border/background/glow colors per state

nodes.name: SelfDamagePerkDef
nodes.description: Interface defining self-damage perk configuration — includes perkName, appliesTo (which attack types trigger it), selfDmgPct, dmgTypes, drPctPerStack, optional flatSelfDmg, procChance, noMultiTargetFalloff

nodes.name: EmotionalState
nodes.description: Union type 'debuff' | 'both' | 'buff' representing the three Emotional perk toggle states

nodes.name: AnyArmorSlotKey
nodes.description: Union type of ArmorSlotKey | InfusionArmorSlotKey — 'helmet' | 'chestplate' | 'leggings' | 'infusionHelmet' | 'infusionChestplate' | 'infusionLeggings'

nodes.name: ModalType
nodes.description: Union type of all possible selection modal identifiers — 'race' | 'guild' | armor/infusion slots | 'ring' | 'infusion-ring' | 'rune' | 'blade' | 'handle' | 'glove' | 'essence' | null

nodes.name: PerkDmgComputedEntry
nodes.description: Interface for computed perk damage entries — includes perk name, amount, base damage, resolved damage types and scalings, typed hit breakdowns finisher/M2, combat mult, scaling mult, condition, proc coeff, secondary effects, trigger chains, slider config

nodes.name: SelfDamagePerkDefImpl
nodes.description: Five concrete SelfDamagePerkDef instances in SELF_DAMAGE_PERK_DEFS: Undead Might (hex+earth, 1/15 dmg, 15% DR/stack), Explosive Charge (fire+physical, 100%, guardbreak), Dark Magic (hex, 0.5%), Bombardier (magic+holy, 6.66%, no falloff), Steam Powered (fire, flat 1 dmg, 30% chance)

nodes.name: calcSelfDamage
nodes.description: Computes total self-damage for a SelfDamagePerkDef — supports percentage-based (preBoostDamageDealt × selfDmgPct × perkDrMult × multiTargetMult × defenseMults) and flat damage (flatSelfDmg × procChance × hitCount × enemiesHit × defenseMults). Multi-target falloff uses harmonic series (1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + ...) unless noMultiTargetFalloff is set

nodes.name: computeArmorEffectiveBoost
nodes.description: Computes effective boost contribution from armor stats against weapon scalings — Σ(scalingVal × armorStats[SCALING_TO_BOOST[key]]) × statMultiplier, used for 'most-effective' armor sorting in selection modals

nodes.name: computeArmorBrawnyEffectiveBoost
nodes.description: Like computeArmorEffectiveBoost but applies Brawny perk conversion (converts non-physical boost stats to physical at Brawny rate first), used for 'brawny' armor sort mode

nodes.name: substringLevenshtein
nodes.description: Fuzzy string matching using full Levenshtein distance on the shorter query against the candidate, used for 'did you mean' suggestions in modal search when no exact results are found. Score threshold = floor(query.length × 0.35)

nodes.name: calcArmorMult
nodes.description: Computes defense multiplier given defense % and penetration — uses piecewise formula: if def ≤ pen + threshold, mult = 1/(1+def-pen) or 1-(def-pen); else mult = 1/(1+def/(1+5×pen)). Returns branch info for display

nodes.name: getApplicableBoosts
nodes.description: Filters typedBoostEntries for a given damage type key, returns matching boosts as {perkName, label, mult} using healMult or dmgMult depending on isHeal flag, supports appliesToGroups filtering and procCoefficient gating

nodes.name: computeActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.description: Resolves active defensive perk sources by calling getActiveDefensivePerkSources with contextual parameters (hp fill, adaptive plate, darkness, rage, mount, protection, debuff count) and applies defensive potency multiplier from Draconic Infusion

nodes.name: seqWithTypes
nodes.description: Maps a hit sequence (numbers or {n, count} objects) to typed damage breakdown entries with damage type distributions, scaling multiplier, rage multiplier for rage-affected types, and combat multiplier

nodes.name: toggleBuffKey
nodes.description: Toggles a buff enable/disable by its 'buffName:sourceName' key, cascading to related disabled sets (Smoldering, Perfection, Minion Absorption) to keep boost toggles in sync with buff toggles

nodes.name: dotScalingMult
nodes.description: Computes DoT scaling multiplier for a damage type — gets effective dot scalings (with Gelid Lance water bonus for Bleed), sums (scalingVal × stat[boostKey]) for each, returns 1 + total/100

nodes.name: buildScalingRows
nodes.description: Builds an array of ScalingRow objects from a scalings record — for each (key, scalingVal), resolves boostKey via SCALING_TO_BOOST, gets stat value, computes contribution = scalingVal × boostPct, assigns color from SCALING_COLORS

nodes.name: SELF_DAMAGE_PERK_DEFS
nodes.description: Array of 5 SelfDamagePerkDef instances covering Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier, and Steam Powered — used by DamageAnalyzer for self-damage computations on applicable hit types

nodes.name: BLOOD_THIRSTY_MULT_PER_STACK
nodes.description: 0.20 multiplier per Blood Thirsty stack for damage boost against bleeding targets

nodes.name: HEAT_DRILL_COOLDOWN
nodes.description: Fixed WA cooldown (15s) for Heat Drill perk replacing Lunge/Barrage cooldowns

nodes.name: VENOM_EATER_HEAL_PER_STACK
nodes.description: 0.1 heal per Venom Eater stack per hit against poisoned targets — used by BaseDamageCalc for Venom Eater heal entries

nodes.name: FRENZY_BASE
nodes.description: Base Frenzy multiplier (0.05) used in Frenzy damage boost calculation combined with rage potency

nodes.name: ESSENCE_RAY_BASE
nodes.description: Base Essence Ray damage (1.1) per hit, scaled by perk stacks and number of hits (23)

nodes.name: UNDEAD_MIGHT_SELF_DMG_FRACTION
nodes.description: 1/15 fraction of damage dealt as self-damage for Undead Might perk

nodes.name: UNDEAD_MIGHT_DR_PCT_PER_STACK
nodes.description: 15% damage resistance per Undead Might stack applied to the self-damage

nodes.name: LIFESTEAL_HEAL_PCT_PER_STACK
nodes.description: 0.005 (0.5%) of damage dealt healed per Lifesteal stack

nodes.name: STEAM_POWERED_MULT_PER_AIR_BOOST
nodes.description: 2/15 multiplier per air boost for Steam Powered damage conversion
